operations.description: Object destructor with ref-count decrement (ABI tag Object_Destructor_with_Ref_Count_Decrement); called from 0x0059A8BC, this=v1 is the object instance.
SEHHandlerInit() sets up the SEH handler frame on the stack for the destructor body.
Save this as v2, store v1 into the SEH frame slot at a1-16, install the vtable pointer off_5B9D3C at *v1, and zero the frame slot at a1-4.
Read the ref-count index v3 = v1[9] (offset 0x24 of the object).
If v3 is null, or decrementing byte_8D463C[v3] leaves the count at or below zero, call sub_59A980(v1) for full cleanup.
NullCheckWithVirtualDispatch(v2 + 8): null-check the pointer at this+0x20 and perform the virtual dispatch.
